evidence: Parent AC4: 'the guard is `isinstance` PRIMARY with a `hasattr(client, member)` fallback ... Pinned by `test_proxying_transport_is_capable_and_is_not_skipped` behind a `sys.version_info` split; ADR divergence in [rebar:5c21-f24a-f7f8-4a55]'
Child a3fa body OPERATOR DECISION: 'Guard shape: `isinstance(client, SupportsComments)` / `isinstance(client, SupportsLinks)` ... Deliberate documented divergence from `fetcher.py`'s `hasattr`'
Child a3fa AC1: 'all four capability call sites are runtime-guarded with `isinstance` against the relevant `@runtime_checkable` capability Protocol' (no fallback)
Child a3fa AC4: 'the divergence from `fetcher.py`'s `hasattr` shape is justified in an in-code comment citing ADR-0083' (justifies moving AWAY from hasattr, not adding a hasattr fallback)
The fallback, proxy hazard, version-split test, and 5c21 pointer appear only in child a3fa's execution-record comments (patchset 1->2 Verified -1 fix), never as an acceptance criterion
findings.finding: Parent AC4 (AMENDED guard shape) is not covered by any child acceptance criterion, and its prescribed shape contradicts child a3fa's own body decision and ACs. The parent AC4 requires the guard to be 'isinstance PRIMARY with a hasattr(client, member) fallback' pinned by 'test_proxying_transport_is_capable_and_is_not_skipped behind a sys.version_info split', with the ADR divergence tracked in rebar:5c21-f24a-f7f8-4a55. Child a3fa's OPERATOR DECISION body and AC1 prescribe an isinstance-ONLY guard, and its AC4 only requires an in-code comment justifying divergence FROM fetcher.py's hasattr shape — the opposite direction. No child AC mentions the hasattr fallback, the proxying-transport/getattr_static hazard, the version-split test, or the 5c21 pointer.
scenarios: A completion verifier checking child a3fa against its ACs confirms isinstance-only guards and an anti-hasattr comment, yet the parent's amended AC4 demands the isinstance-primary + hasattr-fallback shape and a version-split test — the child's ACs cannot attest the parent's criterion.

On Python 3.12 CI, an isinstance-only guard (child AC1/body as written) declares a proxying transport capability-absent and skips its writes by design — the exact defect the parent AC4 amendment says must be prevented by the fallback.
findings.suggested_fix: Update child a3fa AC1 to 'isinstance-primary with a member-level hasattr fallback' and add an explicit AC (or fold into AC4) requiring the version-split proxy test and the 5c21 ADR-divergence link, so the child's ACs deliver the parent's amended AC4 observable outcome rather than the isinstance-only shape.

findings.finding: Child a3fa's guard-shape prescription conflicts with the parent's AMENDED AC4 (conflicting-assumptions mode).
findings.suggested_fix: Update child a3fa to adopt the parent's AMENDED AC4 guard shape verbatim and note the isinstance-only text is superseded, eliminating the contradiction.
